dang po ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3827">kha cig</rs> na re byang chub sems dpa'i sbyor ba dag mtshan nyid mi 'dra ba bzhis bsgrub bya'i khyad par mi 'dra ba bzhis bsgrub pa la dgongs nas mtshan nyid 'di dag gsungs pa yin te |'
gla ིུgnare gyung rtsab sems dpa'i spyor b.radagamu tshan nyid mi'adapa bzhis bsgrub ba'i lyad par mi 'dra ba bzhi ba sgrub bal dgongs nas mtshan nyida'adi dgagasungs pa yinate  de yang shes bdang phed paganyis ni 'bras hu rigs yinal [」]zhyed b.radangango ga ni nirang bzhin gyirags yinano/ de lta yin pang deganyis ri mnyam bzhaganartogs pami 'ad g.yod garjes pho ྒྱི 
<lb n="110b5"/>rtags pas dpog pad phyed pa yinal [」]de las kyo ིsa pa'i mtshan nid kyis ri rnal gyir pa pag ni tshis can tu byas nas gizhi shis pa'i sgyong gdang [」]lam shis pa'i sbyirang garang [」]rnam bzams cad ma thyin pa'i sgyor bgasum bsgoms pani datub sla ba pa la'im pa bzhini tamatshan nyid pacu dug phra ga gsum rtags su gsungs la zhin no/ de dag gi khyab pa gangalas staman yad 'o' 
<lb n="110b6"/>lung la grub pa yin no || de bzhin du byed pa'i mtshan nyid kyis kyang sems can gyi don byed pa'i khyad par mi 'dra ba las rgyu'i khyad par dpog pa yin no ||
khyad par gyi mtsha no nid kyis ni byi rub sems dpa'i syong bdagocis can na thes dang ra rgyul bya'i sbying b.las zhyud pa raru bi lags pa yin ིbsam ragyis gi tyab bamasogs batshachos banu jug dang ldan pa'i 'ir ris pabastan ki 
no/ngagani kyi tshan 'i gyis chimatshon nidartags su ba ོda nas mtshon bying pho snu sgrub bang phyed pa yin/ ni si zong pa/ </seg></TEI>
